direct_transport_contract.endpoint: POST /review-query (strict single-send; no attachments; structurally never clicks Continue/Retry/Answer-now)
direct_transport_contract.digest_bond_note: Amended 2026-08-01 from the browser-era capture delegation. There is no capture step to delegate: the receipt carries the response bytes and their SHA-256, the wrapper archives them write-once, and archive_pro_response.ps1 independently recomputes the digest over the archived file. A mismatch is a refusal, never a repair.
direct_transport_contract.transport_fault_channel_note: Every HMASD_AGENTIFY_TRANSPORT_ERROR code, non-NATURAL_COMPLETION_VERIFIED terminal, HTTP 409, binding mismatch or tab-precondition failure observed during a round is carried into that round's '## Transport faults', and in the same round the Skill is repaired or the reason recorded. tests/review_round_contract_test.ps1 refuses a round whose section is empty or still TODO.
direct_transport_contract.conversation_binding_note: Amended 2026-07-25 from one_per_branch. The rule exists for branch isolation -- a conversation bound to another branch must never serve this one -- not to cap the count. A second conversation on the same branch is permitted only when it carries a distinct reviewer role with its own charter. Every round names the reviewer key it targets; transport never infers it.
direct_transport_contract.stable_key_binding_note: Agentify persists stableKey -> conversation on first /review-query and refuses re-pointing (review_binding_mismatch). A tab record's URL is fixed at creation, so the key's FIRST send must let /review-query create the tab itself: submit --allow-tab-creation, once per key, after confirming no tab with that key exists (measured 2026-08-01). Every later operation requires that exact idle tab and never creates, navigates or repairs tabs.

open_divergent.charter: Scientific authority over protected semantics. Rules on estimands, gates, branch meaning, smallest refuted unit, and every protected decision routed to it. Retains a mandatory unmediated primary-evidence read.

adjudicator.charter: Maps adversarial-reader findings onto the sealed ground-truth inventory for workflow validation, and reports disputes. A match requires the same violated invariant, the same smallest consequence, and an independently established evidence path; language similarity is neither necessary nor sufficient. Never designs the mechanism, never rules on protected scientific semantics, never authorizes compute.

blinding.reason: The external ruling requires an adjudicator not involved in mechanism design or generation. Exposure to the design voids V1 and V2.
must_never_receive: any CURRENT_WORK.md revision describing the grill mechanism
blinding.standing_contract_leakage_checked: 2026-07-25 -- ALGORITHM_PRINCIPLES.md and OPEN_REVIEW_PRINCIPLES.md contain zero mechanism references, so the preflight-mandated allow-list entries do not break blinding. Recheck if either file gains grill content.

adjudicator.independence_caveat: This session shares a model with open_divergent. It buys throughput and freedom from design exposure -- NOT independence of judgement. Agreement between the two reviewers is never corroboration, and this session must never be used as a second discovery channel.

registration_rule: A reviewer whose registration_status is not 'registered', or whose conversation_id or url is null, blocks transport. The Project Manager registers the conversation by recording its exact id and url here before the first round. Transport never selects a conversation by title, recency or similarity.
role_targeting_rule: Every round names its target reviewer key explicitly in the assignment. Transport never chooses between registered reviewers, and never cross-posts a round or its reply between them. Posting design material into a blinded reviewer is a validation-voiding error, not a recoverable transport fault.

retired_registrations.reason: Belonged to the aggressive branch under Codex-era in-app-browser transport. Conversations are bound one per branch, so untied-k needs its own. Never reuse.
